description: This file implements the code-behind for an ASP.NET WebForms page (MCQSet.aspx) in an online examination system, providing functionality for administrative question and exam management, including dynamic course selection based on semester, adding questions, setting exams, and navigation.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the SetExam ASP.NET page, handling question set operations, course selection, navigation, and database interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the page when loaded. Currently commented out logic for session-based question number retrieval.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel.aspx page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester, adding courses corresponding to each academic year and semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input fields for question data.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a multiple-choice question to the database, updates question number, and provides user feedback.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets an exam for a selected course by inserting exam details into the database.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles dynamic course list population when the semester dropdown selection changes.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on current course question count.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the login page.
